title: Sampling Random Graphs from the Colored Configuration Model

problem.claim: Knowledge discovery requires statistical assessment of data mining results, including comparison with randomized versions of observed networks.

gap.claim: Available graph null models preserve only simple characteristics of the observed graph, such as its degree sequence.

narrative_sequence.summary: Statistical assessment is presented as a fundamental step in knowledge discovery.
Network analysis evaluates procedures by comparison with randomized versions of observed networks.
Existing graph null models preserve only simple observed-graph characteristics.

unknowns: The proposed colored configuration model or sampling procedure is not described.
The graph characteristics preserved beyond degree sequence are not specified.
No experiments, datasets, quantitative results, or limitations are reported.
